title: Tasktrail task-note frontmatter
description: The flat YAML frontmatter block of a per-task note in tasktrail/notes/*.md (also the export/vault note contract v2). Values are described by their logical type AFTER the plugin's flat-YAML parse; empty scalars render as the string "". Tasktrail spec_version 1.0. See docs/spec/TASKTRAIL.md.

schema-version.description: Note contract major version. 2 = the v2 contract (uuid/closed/resolvable Related).

uuid.description: Stable task id — matches the event envelope task.uuid.

seq.description: Human-facing per-vault sequence, or "" when unassigned.

status.description: open | active | closed (free-form; open/closed are the load-bearing values).

closed.description: The REAL close date, stamped once from closed_ts; "" while open.

owner.description: Shared-vault owner handle; present only when the producer stamped an owner.

glossary.description: First-class OPTIONAL field. In frontmatter each term is FLATTENED to a single scalar (the plugin's generic renderer stringifies the term object) — NOT machine-structured. The structured {name,layer,state,def} shape lives in the checkpoint/snapshot digest (tasktrail.event.schema.json). Present only when the task carries a glossary.

brief_path.description: First-class OPTIONAL field. Path (relative to the note/export root) to a rendered brief artifact. Present only when the task carries one.
